name: Tracker
description: This algorithm is based on the disting EX algorithm of the same name. The pitch shifter part of the EX algorithm was split out into a separate algorithm on the NT, which you can combine with this algorithm if it suits your needs. The algorithm tracks the pitch and envelope of an audio signal, which are output as CVs. It can also generate chords to harmonise with the tracked pitch – either as pitch CVs (to drive VCOs etc.) or as pitch shifter CVs (to drive the Pitch Shifter, to make harmony copies of the tracked audio). The chords can be tuned microtonally using Scala or MTS.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Sets the range of pitches which can be tracked. Set this appropriately for the lowest note that you need to track.

output_ports.description: The change trigger output bus – emits a trigger pulse when the current tracked note changes.
